# Foundation alpha

This production jar targets Fabric Minecraft 1.20.1. Install Fabric API and
Architectury API 9.2.14 for Fabric 1.20.1 alongside it. Java 17 is the baseline.

Build checks and 19 core tests passed with the local environment adaptation in
../docs/VALIDATION.md. Live bootstrap/worldgen and full modpack acceptance have not
been performed. Use the disposable-world protocol in ../docs/TESTING.md first.
